svg.title: For q < m, include the second identity at m −1 into Em to see πm,q = 0. Inclusion compatibility follows from L. Set Hm = T i<m ker πi,m. Applying each lower projection to the recursion, using induction on earlier homogeneous pieces and cancelling its matching term, proves Km(Em) ⊂Hm. The same identities make the projections fix their own homogeneous space and annihilate the other included pieces. Choose once a real compatible basis em,α of Hm, α ∈Cm. For cluster reader value Am(x, a; o) define hm = KmAm ∈Hm, hm = X α Cm,αem,α.
